name: [Negative] App Crashes & Poor Customer Support
description: Users are experiencing technical issues with the app, including crashes, and struggling to receive assistance from customer support, with some reports of unresponsive or unhelpful support personnel.

name: [Negative] Inadequate Customer Support
description: Users report struggling to get assistance from customer support, with issues not being resolved, long wait times, and difficulty in connecting with representatives.

name: [Negative] Poor Customer Support
description: Users report repeated failures to resolve issues, long wait times, lack of response, and unhelpful interactions, leading to a perception that the support team is ineffective and untrustworthy.

name: [Negative] Poor Customer Support
description: Users consistently report that customer support is unresponsive, unhelpful, and sometimes non-existent, leading to frustration over unresolved issues and delays in refunds or withdrawals.
